Privacy Policy

Odyssey Therapeutics, Inc. (“Odyssey,” “we,” “us” or “our”) respects the privacy of visitors to its website and is committed to the protection of their personal information. This privacy statement explains how Odyssey collects, uses and discloses personal information collected on Odyssey’s website and other websites that link to this Policy.

Personal Information We Collect

Depending on your interactions with Odyssey, Odyssey and its partners may collect personal information, including sensitive personal information, from you and other sources. For instance, Odyssey may collect personal information from you if you provide it on the website. Odyssey may also collect personal information from other sources, such as from publicly available information or third-party vendors. The categories of personal information we may collect includes:

  • Identifiers and contact information, such as name, address, telephone number or e-mail address;
  • Demographic information, such as your age, race or gender;
  • Other information you choose to provide when you contact us;
  • Automatically collected information, such as internet activity and other information from the devices and browsers that you use, including your device type and IP address; and
  • Any inferences we may create about you based on the personal data described above.

While some of the personal information that Odyssey collects may be considered sensitive personal information under certain U.S. state laws, we use and disclose sensitive personal information for purposes that are authorized by law, such as to perform the services you request from us.

How We May Use Personal Information

We may use each of the categories of personal information described above to respond to your requests; provide and improve our level of service and the content of our website; provide you with tips, helpful information, news and updates; notify you of new Odyssey products and services; for our own internal purposes; and to comply with laws and regulations.

To the extent applicable law requires a legal basis to process personal information, we generally do so on the basis of our legitimate interests that include operating our business, providing and maintaining our website, sharing relevant information, responding to requests, enforcing our Terms & Conditions, and for other purposes related to providing and improving our products and services. We also process personal information to fulfill contractual obligations (such as our Terms & Conditions), as well as to comply with applicable law. If required by applicable law, we will seek your consent to process your personal information, such as where applicable law may require consent for us to send you marketing materials.

Cookies and Similar Technologies

We and others may use a variety of technologies to collect information about your device and your use of our website. These technologies include “cookies,” Pixels, web beacons and other technologies. A cookie is a small text file that is placed on your hard disk by a web page server. Cookies help provide additional functionality to the website or help us analyze usage of the website more accurately. For instance, our server may set a cookie that keeps you from having to enter a password more than once during a visit to the website.

The following types of cookies are used on our website:

  • Necessary Cookies: Necessary cookies are required to enable the basic features of our site, such as providing secure log-in or adjusting your consent preferences and cannot be switched off in our systems. They may enable the disclosure of your information to some of our business partners but are usually only set in response to actions made by you that amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but in that case some parts of the site will not work. If you do not agree to the use and disclosure of your information pursuant to these cookies, you should not use the website.
  • Functional Cookies: Functional cookies help perform certain functionalities like sharing the content of the website on social media platforms, collecting feedback and other third-party features. They may be set by us or by business partners and may enable the disclosure of your information to those partners. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
  • Performance Cookies: Performance cookies are used to understand and analyze the key performance indexes of the website, which helps in delivering a better user experience for the visitors. These cookies allow us, or our analytics providers, to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site and may enable the disclosure of your information to those business partners. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site and will not be able to monitor its performance.
  • Advertising Cookies: Advertising cookies are used by us and our partners to provide visitors with customized advertisements based on the pages you visited previously and to analyze the effectiveness of any ad campaigns. Third parties may collect this information over time and combine it with information collected on different websites and online services across your devices. When you visit another website of an advertisement network, customized pop-ups tailored to your interests can be presented to you on the basis of the information collected on our site.

You may have the ability to accept or decline cookies. Most web browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can usually modify your browser setting to decline cookies, or receive a warning before a cookie is stored, if you prefer. Please refer to your internet browser’s instructions or help screen to learn more about these functions. If you choose to decline cookies, you may not be able to fully experience the interactive features of this website or any other websites that you visit.

We currently do not respond to browser “Do Not Track” signals, as there is no standard for how online services should respond to such signals.

How We May Disclose Personal Information

We may disclose each of the categories of personal information as described in this privacy policy and as permitted by applicable law.

  • Vendors and affiliates: We may work with various vendors, including affiliated companies, that help us operate our business and in doing so, may have access to your personal information to provide services to Odyssey. For example, we may disclose personal data to vendors that help us operate our website, analyze website data and provide support services. Odyssey requires such vendors to meet appropriate standards of data protection.
  • Other business partners: We may also disclose personal data to other business partners, including our external auditors, attorneys, accountants and similar professionals based on our legitimate interest in the operation of our business and our obligations to comply with applicable laws and regulations.
  • For legal reasons: We may disclose personal information to comply with a legal obligation; to enforce our agreements or policies; to protect the rights, property and safety of Odyssey, our partners, and others; to comply with our regulatory obligations (e.g., to comply with our reporting obligations to governing authorities regarding the safety of our products); or to meet applicable national security or law enforcement requirements.
  • With your consent: We may disclose personal information if you give us permission to do so or direct us to share information.
  • To complete a corporate transaction: We may disclose or transfer personal information in connection with a corporate transaction (e.g., a merger, consolidation, asset sale, or bankruptcy).

Links to Other Websites

This website may provide links to other Odyssey and third-party websites as a service to our users. The privacy statement described here does not apply to those websites. Please ensure you check the legal and privacy statement posted on each website you link to.

Your Rights

Depending on where you live and subject to exceptions, you may have certain rights with respect to Odyssey’s use and disclosure of your personal information.

  • Right to Know: You may have the right to know information about what personal information the business has collected about you.
  • Right to Access and Portability: You may have the right to request a copy of the personal information we collected about you.
  • Right to Delete and Correct: You may have the right to request that we delete certain about collected from you or correct inaccuracies in the personal information we retain about you.
  • Right to Withdraw Consent: If we rely on consent to process your personal information, you may withdraw that consent.
  • Right to be Free from Discrimination: You may have the right to exercise your rights without unlawful discrimination.
  • Appeal: If we deny a request, you may have the right to appeal. To exercise an appeal, please email info@odysseytx.com.

We do not sell personal information to third parties or share it for purposes of cross-context behavioral advertising or targeted advertising. Advertising partners may also use cookies and other tracking technologies to collect information about your activities across different websites and services to build a profile of your interests and provide you with relevant advertising. We do not knowingly sell or share for targeted advertising the personal information of people under 16 years of age.

To exercise your rights to know, access, portability, delete, correct and withdraw consent, please email info@odysseytx.com.

Odyssey will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights. Once we receive your request, we may verify it by requesting information sufficient to confirm your identity. You may be entitled to submit a request through an authorized agent. However, we may request information to confirm that the authorized agent is entitled to exercise rights on your behalf.

We may deny requests as allowed by applicable law, such as where we have a reasonable belief that the request is fraudulent, where your identity cannot be confirmed, or where Odyssey must retain your information consistent with applicable law. You can, however, appeal those requests that we deny as set out above. Where provided by applicable law, you may also lodge a complaint with a privacy regulatory authority in your jurisdiction.

Changes

We may occasionally update this legal and privacy statement. When we do so, we will update the “Updated” date below. We encourage you to periodically review this legal and privacy statement to stay informed about how we are helping to protect the personal information we collect. Your continued use of our website constitutes your agreement to our privacy statement and any updates.

Retention

Odyssey stores personal information as reasonably necessary and proportionate to accomplish the purposes set out in this privacy policy in accordance with applicable law.

Children

We do not intend for our websites or online services to be used by anyone under the age of 16. We also do not knowingly sell or share for targeted advertising the personal information of consumers between the ages of 13 – 16.

International Transfers

When you use the website and provide us with personal information, we may transfer and store your information on servers located outside your resident jurisdiction. Where that is the case, we take steps in accordance with applicable law to protect your personal information.

Contact Odyssey

To contact Odyssey with questions, comments or concerns about privacy you may email us at info@odysseytx.com.

Updated: November 6, 2024
